_comment: Data file for avatartrace. See CONTRIBUTING.md ('Adding a platform') for the meaning of every field.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.avatar_note: Public profiles expose og:image to logged-out clients on many networks; data-centre and some regional IPs are redirected to the login page instead.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.avatar_note: TikTok serves a JavaScript bot challenge to non-browser clients, so the avatar is normally not retrievable.

platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.avatar_note: Public Pages and profiles that allow search-engine previews expose og:image; private or restricted profiles return a login page.

platforms.name: X (Twitter)
platforms.avatar_note: Without X_BEARER_TOKEN the avatar is read from the image preload hint in the public profile HTML, which X may change or withhold at any time.

platforms.name: Reddit
platforms.avatar_note: Reddit blocks logged-out, non-browser clients; set REDDIT_CLIENT_ID and REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET (a free 'script' app) to use the official API.

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.avatar_note: Channel pages expose og:image; in the EU a consent interstitial can replace the page, in which case set YOUTUBE_API_KEY to use the Data API.

platforms.name: LinkedIn
platforms.avatar_note: LinkedIn answers logged-out, non-browser clients with HTTP 999 or an auth wall, so profile pictures are not retrievable.

platforms.name: Snapchat
platforms.avatar_note: Snapchat returns HTTP 404 for public profiles when the client is not a browser, so the picture is not retrievable.

platforms.name: VK
platforms.avatar_note: VK redirects logged-out, non-browser clients to a generic page without profile data.

platforms.name: Mastodon / Fediverse
platforms.avatar_note: Any host using Mastodon-style /@user URLs is tried through the standard public lookup API; non-Mastodon hosts simply drop out as 'account not found'.

platforms.name: Spotify
platforms.avatar_note: Spotify user IDs are not chosen usernames, so Spotify is not part of username expansion.

platforms.name: Medium
platforms.avatar_note: Medium sits behind Cloudflare bot protection and answers non-browser clients with HTTP 403.

platforms.name: Patreon
platforms.avatar_note: This site sits behind bot protection or does not expose the profile picture in page metadata, so results are usually UNVERIFIED.

platforms.name: Behance
platforms.avatar_note: This site sits behind bot protection or does not expose the profile picture in page metadata, so results are usually UNVERIFIED.

platforms.name: Dribbble
platforms.avatar_note: Dribbble's og:image is a shot, not the avatar, and the page offers no machine-readable avatar, so results are UNVERIFIED.
